fee_notes: Standard fee $135,000. Reduced to $60,000 for existing franchisees in good standing purchasing an additional franchise (no broker commission). Veterans discount of $20,000 reduces fee to $115,000. Asset purchase of existing operating franchise: $40,000. Transfer buyer fee: $40,000. Fee not refundable once Franchise Agreement signed.
raw_excerpt: You must pay an initial license fee of $135,000 for the School you will develop under the Franchise Agreement
